subject.title: Add backup/restore utility for config, cron jobs, and session history

question: What first-party backup/restore scope should OpenClaw own before implementation: local restore/import only, component-aware cron/session restore, or the full cloud/encryption/scheduled workflow?
rationale: The remaining work changes sensitive persisted state and product boundaries, and the right split between core restore safety and plugin/ClawHub cloud backup cannot be inferred from code alone.

options.title: Core Local Restore First
options.body: Define and implement local manifest-driven restore/import with dry-run, conflict handling, rollback, and explicit secret/session policy, leaving cloud scheduling to plugins until the core contract is stable.

options.title: Full Native Backup Platform
options.body: Treat cloud storage, encryption, scheduling, retention, and component merge semantics as first-party OpenClaw CLI scope, accepting a broader security and maintenance surface.

options.title: Plugin-Led Cloud Backup
options.body: Keep first-party core to archive create/verify and extension APIs, while routing cloud backup/restore UX through vetted ClawHub plugins unless a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Core Local Restore First
recommendation.body: Define and implement local manifest-driven restore/import with dry-run, conflict handling, rollback, and explicit secret/session policy, leaving cloud scheduling to plugins until the core contract is stable.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent substantive issue review from this handle kept the umbrella open and framed the remaining work as a maintainer product/security decision.
